ai_summary: Advait Energy Transitions Limited reported robust Q2/H1 FY27 financial results, with consolidated operating income growing 40.8% and EBITDA increasing 84.4% year-over-year, driven by strong performance in its Power Transmission Solutions (PTS) business and improved margins. The company is aggressively expanding into New and Renewable Energy (NRE) segments like Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Green Hydrogen with significant manufacturing investments and strategic partnerships, reflected in a 47% YoY growth in its order book. While the unaudited nature of these interim results and the substantial capital expenditure required for NRE expansion are factors to monitor, the overall strategic shift indicates a clear path towards capitalizing on India's energy transition.
